recommendation: Introduce transport support for antenatal visits
finding: 42 per cent of surveyed women reported difficulty reaching the health facility (household survey, Q14).
assumption: Travel time or transport availability, rather than cost, staff attitudes or opening hours, is what constrains service use.
evidence_for_assumption: Reported difficulty is higher in villages more than 5 km from the PHC (58 per cent) than within 5 km (31 per cent); no data on cost or staffing yet.
what_would_make_it_wrong: If difficulty is driven by facility opening hours or by who accompanies women, a transport subsidy moves money and not attendance. A qualitative follow-up in the two worst villages would settle this.

recommendation: Scale the programme to three more districts
finding: Attendance rose 11 points in treatment villages over 18 months.
